frequency_question: How often do announced steep sectoral tariffs on major integrated trade partners take effect on schedule rather than being delayed or superseded by a deal?
membership_rule: Includes unilateral tariff announcements by the U.S. executive targeting key allies or integrated partners (Canada, Mexico, EU, China) with a stated implementation date under one year away. Excludes standard anti-dumping or countervailing duties by agencies.

cases.name: Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariffs on Canada and Mexico
Threatened Tariffs on Mexico over Border Security

coverage_note: 4 named episodes representing major executive tariff leverage attempts against integrated partners.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller sector-specific exclusions and minor disputes.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 4 total comparable high-stakes leverage episodes
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of current executive trade policy frameworks and bargaining styles.
